A tongue-in-cheek encounter at the Dou Sai Restaurant in Hue.
Apr 2025 • Couples
In the meandering lanes of Hue, we ran into this treasure restaurant named Doosama! From the mellow bottom of the first bite of Hue beef flour to the refreshing shrapnel of a rice roll, every dish is like a traditional dance on the tip of the tongue. The most stunning is the Vietnamese baguette sandwich - a crispy crust with secret prickly meat and sour and sweet pickles hidden under it, a bite full of layers! The boss was as enthusiastic as an old friend and taught us to dip in authentic fish. Even picky boyfriends boast while eating: 'It's definitely worth it.
